# Test fixtures

## `jamman-sd/` — synthetic JamMan Stereo SD card

**This SD card is synthetic.** It was generated by
[`generate-jamman-sd.mjs`](generate-jamman-sd.mjs), not copied from a real pedal
card, so it contains no user audio. It is deliberately tiny (~50 KB) and
deterministic (fixed IDs and waveforms).

Layout (deduced from `packages/main/src/index.ts`, `SecureXMLParser.ts` and
`PathValidator.ts`):

```
jamman-sd/
├── Patch01/                  # /^Patch\d{2}$/
│   ├── patch.xml             # <JamManPatch>: PatchName, RhythmType, StopMode, ID, OriginID…
│   └── PhraseA/              # /^Phrase[A-Z]$/
│       ├── phrase.xml        # <JamManPhrase>: BeatsPerMinute, BeatsPerMeasure, IsLoop, IsReversed, ID…
│       └── phrase.wav        # 16-bit stereo 44.1 kHz PCM, 64 frames (~0.0015 s)
├── Patch02/                  # two phrases (PhraseA, PhraseB)
└── Patch03/
```

| Patch   | Name        | ID (`<ID>`)                            | Phrases          |
| ------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Patch01 | Rock Groove | `000000a0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` | PhraseA          |
| Patch02 | Waltz Pair  | `000000a0-0000-4000-8000-000000000002` | PhraseA, PhraseB |
| Patch03 | Slow Blues  | `000000a0-0000-4000-8000-000000000003` | PhraseA          |

The same data is exposed to tests as `SD_FIXTURE_PATCHES` in [`index.ts`](index.ts).

### Using it in tests

Never write into `jamman-sd/` itself. Copy it to a temp directory:

```ts
import { createTempSd, SD_FIXTURE_PATCHES } from '../../../tests/fixtures/index.js';

const sd = createTempSd(); // sd.path is a fresh copy of the SD
afterEach(() => sd.cleanup());
```

`createTempDir()` gives an empty temp directory, and `createTempSd(source)` copies
any other SD tree.

### Replacing it with a real card

1. Copy the contents of a real JamMan Stereo SD card (the `PatchNN` folders) into
   `tests/fixtures/jamman-sd/`, replacing the synthetic ones. Keep it small: a few
   patches, and trim or replace large WAVs (anything over a few hundred KB).
   Remove any audio you do not have the right to publish.
2. Update `SD_FIXTURE_PATCHES` in `index.ts` and the table above (dirs, names,
   `<ID>` values, phrases). Tests import that constant, so they follow.
3. Do **not** run `generate-jamman-sd.mjs` afterwards: it deletes and rebuilds
   `jamman-sd/`. Delete the script too if you no longer want the synthetic card.
4. Tests that depend on specific values (e.g. a patch with two phrases) may need
   adjusting; run `npm test`.

To rebuild the synthetic card: `node tests/fixtures/generate-jamman-sd.mjs`.
